trades.label: PAPER / SIMULATED
trades.name: jeff
trades.time_basis: Entry is the next candle open. Exit is that candle's end (open plus the bar size). Free OHLCV has no intrabar fill time.
trades.strategy_name: Buy the dip when price is 60–80% off the window high (trading at 20–40% of that high), only after a green bar that does not set the high. Never top-tick. Stop 8% below the next open, target 15% above, time-stop after 8 hourly bars. Stop is filled first if a bar touches both.
trades.ath_note: ATH is the max high across fetched GeckoTerminal daily candles (up to the configured limit) and hourly candles. When the free endpoint returns a shorter window, this is not a lifetime ATH. The backtest seeds its running high with daily highs that printed before the first hourly bar only.
